cells.gaps: A Ministry portal, undated and read as 2025 (LBR-017), says the EMIS tracks every learner from ECE to senior secondary on a unique identifier, against the Ministry's own dated statements of 29 September 2026 that the existing system is paper-based and the learner ID planned (LBR-001, LBR-002); the newer stands. No row shows staff trained, equipment delivered, an agreement signed or pilot schools for a school-level EMIS or the learner ID system; finance:domestic is the plan's 60 per cent framework, not a budget line shown. LBR-006 is from the excluded source and sets nothing.
cells.note: Stage 1 on the Ministry's own dated statements of 29 September 2026 that the existing system is paper-based and that schools feeding attendance to a central system is a goal not yet reached; the portal's earlier claim of per-learner records does not outweigh them. Not stage 2, because what is held is a validated plan and a policy consultation, not preparation or a pilot in schools.
